o_work_monitor_recovery.policy: Inspect latest O authoritative state and fresh owner activity. Never create duplicate writer while current owner is fresh. Recover only after actual stop is established, using existing lease/fence/CAS contracts. Individual blockers are not global completion. Never self-disable; only explicit user stop. Apply least-Work routing and do not interrupt valid frozen Work-exclusive execution. Persist monitoring/recovery evidence durably.

o_human_request_monitor.policy: Read durable O user-request queue from current main, notify only newly open/changed/reopened requests, do not mutate O/queue, do not duplicate unchanged notifications, transient read failures are retried next run and never become completion.
